17998-before-the-war.title: Before The War
17998-before-the-war.creator: Viscount Haldane
17998-before-the-war.description: A book by Viscount Haldane. rting war, and in the second place to preparing for it as well as was practicable if it should come. In reviewing what happened I have made use of the substance of various papers recently contributed to the _Westminster Gazette_, the _Atlantic Monthly_, _Land and Water_, and the _Sunday Times_.

32688-the-ordeal-of-colonel-johns.title: The Ordeal Of Colonel Johns
32688-the-ordeal-of-colonel-johns.creator: Unknown
32688-the-ordeal-of-colonel-johns.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. or rather bigger, smiling at Mrs. Appleby-Simpkin, the Past President, beaming at Mrs. Lynd-Torris, a defeated candidate for the presidency and whose ancestor had been only a captain, and completely ignoring Mrs. Tolman, the other defeated candidate whose ancestor had been so inconsiderate as to have been a Continental sergeant.

arxiv-1908-04263.title: Computation of Jacobi sums of orders l 2 l^{2} and 2 ​ l 2 2l^{2} with prime l l
arxiv-1908-04263.creator: Md Helal Ahmed, Jagmohan Tanti and Sumant Pusph
arxiv-1908-04263.description: Abstract . In this article, we present the fast computational algorithms for the Jacobi sums of orders l 2 l^{2} and 2 ​ l 2 2l^{2} with odd prime l l by formulating them in terms of the minimum number of cyclotomic numbers of the corresponding orders.

arxiv-2211-15283.title: Double-replica theory for evolution of genotype-phenotype interrelationship
arxiv-2211-15283.creator: Tuan Minh Pham, Kunihiko Kaneko
arxiv-2211-15283.description: Abstract The relationship between genotype and phenotype plays a crucial role in determining the function and robustness of biological systems. Here the evolution progresses through the change in genotype, whereas the selection is based on the phenotype, and genotype-phenotype relation also evolves. Theory for such phenotypic evolution remains poorly-developed, in contrast to evolution under the fitness landscape determined by genotypes.

arxiv-2307-07886.title: When do tripdoublet states fluoresce? A theoretical study of copper(II) porphyrin
arxiv-2307-07886.creator: Xingwen Wang, Chenyu Wu, Zikuan Wang, Wenjian Liu
arxiv-2307-07886.description: Abstract Open-shell molecules rarely fluoresce, due to their typically faster non-radiative relaxation rates compared to closed-shell ones. Even rarer is the fluorescence from states that have two more unpaired electrons than the open-shell ground state, for example tripdoublet states (a triplet excitation antiferromagnetically coupled to a doublet state).

arxiv-2308-08941.title: Automatic Signboard Recognition in Low Quality Night Images
arxiv-2308-08941.creator: Manas Kagde, Priyanka Choudhary, Rishi Joshi, Somnath Dey
arxiv-2308-08941.description: Abstract An essential requirement for driver assistance systems and autonomous driving technology is implementing a robust system for detecting and recognizing traffic signs. This system enables the vehicle to autonomously analyze the environment and make appropriate decisions regarding its movement, even when operating at higher frame rates.

arxiv-2407-00354.title: On selection dynamics for a nonlocal phenotype-structured model
arxiv-2407-00354.creator: Shen Bian, Jiale Bu
arxiv-2407-00354.description: Abstract This paper is devoted to the analysis of the long-time behavior of a phenotypic-structured model where phenotypic changes do not occur. We give a mathematical description of the process in which the best adapted trait is selected in a given environment created by the total population.

arxiv-2507-20014.title: Policy-Driven AI in Dataspaces: Taxonomy, Explainability, and Pathways for Compliant Innovation
arxiv-2507-20014.creator: Joydeep Chandra, Satyam Kumar Navneet
arxiv-2507-20014.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joydeep Chandra, Satyam Kumar Navneet. As AI-driven dataspaces become integral to data sharing and collaborative analytics, ensuring privacy, performance, and policy compliance presents significant challenges. This paper provides a comprehensive review of privacy-preserving and policy-aware AI techniques, including Federated Learning, Differential Privacy, Trusted Execution Environments, Homomorphic Encryption, and Secure Multi-Party Computation, alongside strategies for aligning AI with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR and the EU AI Act.

arxiv-2510-04126.title: Attending on Multilevel Structure of Proteins enables Accurate Prediction of Cold-Start Drug-Target Interactions
arxiv-2510-04126.creator: Ziying Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Yuxuan Sun, Min Ye, Quanming Yao
arxiv-2510-04126.description: Abstract Cold-start drug-target interaction (DTI) prediction focuses on interaction between novel drugs and proteins. Previous methods typically learn transferable interaction patterns between structures of drug and proteins to tackle it. However, insight from proteomics suggest that protein have multi-level structures and they all influence the DTI.

arxiv-2601-00945.title: JWST observations of three long-period AM CVn binaries: detection of the donors and hints of magnetically truncated disks
arxiv-2601-00945.creator: Kareem El-Badry 1, Antonio C. Rodriguez 2,1, Matthew J. Green 3,4, Kevin B. Burdge 5
arxiv-2601-00945.description: Abstract We present JWST /NIRSpec high-cadence infrared spectroscopy of three long-period, eclipsing AM CVn binaries, Gaia14aae, SRGeJ0453, and ZTFJ1637. These systems have orbital periods of 50–62 minutes and cool donors that are undetectable in the optical. The data cover a wavelength range of 1.6–5.2 μ \mu m at resolution R = 1000 − 2000 R=1000-2000 .

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-pope-marinus-.description: Article 'Pope Marinus II' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10704730.title: A meta-analysis of genetic and phenotypic diversity of European local pig breeds reveals genomic regions associated with breed differentiation for production traits
pmc-10704730.creator: Klavdija Poklukar, Camille Mestre, Martin Škrlep, Marjeta Čandek-Potokar, Cristina Ovilo, Luca Fontanesi, Juliette Riquet, Samuele Bovo, Giuseppina Schiavo, Anisa Ribani, Maria Muñoz, Maurizio Gallo, Ricardo Bozzi, Rui Charneca, Raquel Quintanilla, Goran Kušec, Marie-José Mercat, Christoph Zimmer, V
pmc-10704730.description: BackgroundIntense selection of modern pig breeds has resulted in genetic improvement of production traits while the performance of local pig breeds has remained lower. As local pig breeds have been bred in extensive systems, they have adapted to specific environmental conditions, resulting in a rich genotypic and phenotypic diversity.

pmc-11548311.title: Modeling of Static Stress Identification Using Electromechanical Impedance of Embedded Piezoelectric Plate
pmc-11548311.creator: Xianfeng Wang, Hui Liu, Guoxiong Liu, Dan Xu, Iren E Kuznetsova
pmc-11548311.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Working stress is an important indicator reflecting the health status of structures. Passive-monitoring technology using the piezoelectric effect can effectively monitor the dynamic stress of structures. However, under static loads, the charge generated by the piezoelectric devices can only be preserved when the external circuit impedance is infinitely large, which means passive-monitoring techniques are unable to monitor static and quasi-static stress caused by slow-changing actions.

pmc-11643661.title: Synthesis, Crystal Structures, Antimicrobial Activity, and Acute Toxicity Evaluation of Chiral Zn(II) Schiff Base Complexes
pmc-11643661.creator: Daniela Gutiérrez Arguelles, Claudia P Villamizar, Eduardo Brambila-Colombres, Bertin Anzaldo, Angel Mendoza, Guadalupe Hernández Téllez, Pankaj Sharma, Mauro Ravera
pmc-11643661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Four mononuclear bioefficient zinc coordination complexes [Zn(NN)3](ClO4)2 (A–D) involving chiral bidentate Schiff base ligands have been synthesized and characterized by IR, 1H, and 13C NMR spectroscopy and mass spectrometry. X-ray crystal structures of three of the zinc complexes revealed that the zinc metal ion is hexacoordinated, exhibiting a distorted octahedral geometry where both the nitrogen atoms (NN = pyridyl and imine) of imines are coordinated to the central zinc ion.

pmc-11693286.title: ENHANCING DEMENTIA CLASSIFICATION FOR DIVERSE GROUPS: TRANSFORMER-BASED CONTINUOUS SCORING OF CLOCK DRAWING TEST
pmc-11693286.creator: Mengyao Hu, Yi Murphey, Tian Qin, Laura Zahodne, Richard Gonzalez, Vicki Freedman
pmc-11693286.description: Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) significantly impact older adults’ quality of life and pose challenges to public health systems. The clock-drawing test (CDT) is a widely used dementia screening tool due to its ease of administration and effectiveness. However, manual CDT-coding in large-scale studies can be time-intensive and prone to coding errors.

pmc-11713285.title: Network‐based prediction and real‐world patient data observation identifies Doxycycline and Irbesartan as candidate medicines for Alzheimer’s disease and Traumatic Brain Injury
pmc-11713285.creator: Marina Bykova, Michael Danziger, Michal Rosen‐Zvi, Andrew A Pieper, Feixiong Cheng
pmc-11713285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTraumatic Brain Injury (TBI) is one of the most common nonheritable causes of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). However, there is lack of effective treatment for both AD and TBI. We posit that network‐based integration of multi‐omics and endophenotype disease module coupled with large real‐world patient data analysis of electronic health records (EHR) can help identify repurposable drug candidates for the treatment of TBI and AD.MethodWe have collected a total of 69 TBI‐related genes and 144 AD‐related genes derived from human genetic and multi‐omics

pmc-12553150.title: Efficacy of cannabis oil on appetite and quality of life in systemic sclerosis patients: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
pmc-12553150.creator: Veeradej Pisprasert, Bungon Sripanichkulchai, Teerawat Khannongpho, Amonrat Jumnainsong, Ajanee Mahakkanukrauh, Siraphop Suwannaroj, Patnarin Pongkulkiat, Tippawan Onchan, Somdej Kanokmedhakul, Apichart So-ngern, Chingching Foocharoen
pmc-12553150.description: BackgroundThe efficacy of cannabinoids as appetite stimulants in chronic wasting disorders is well established; however, their role in systemic sclerosis (SSc) remains to be elucidated. We aimed to evaluate the efficacy of cannabis oil on appetite, inflammatory markers, quality of life (QoL), and adverse events in patients with SSc compared to placebo.

pmc-12659531.title: Premenstrual syndrome and its association with exposure to political violence, human insecurity, and well-being: a cross-sectional study among Palestinian adolescent refugees
pmc-12659531.creator: Nao Wakabayashi, Mohammed B. A. Sarhan, Rika Fujiya, Daisuke Sugiyama, Rie Fuse, Weeam Hammoudeh, Rula Ghandour
pmc-12659531.description: BackgroundPremenstrual syndrome (PMS) is a common menstruation-related condition among adolescent girls. Vulnerability to environmental and social factors such as living under war, exposure to political violence (EPV), and human insecurity significantly influence the health and well-being of adolescents more generally. However, research on the association between PMS and social determinants in conflict settings remains limited.

pmc-12722534.title: How common? Exploring the prevalence and risk factors for Pseudomonas aeruginosa in diabetic foot infections among kidney transplant recipients
pmc-12722534.creator: Mario Escoriza Gonzalez, Daniel A Burack, Margaret McCort, Phyu Thwe, Luz Liriano-Ward, Rohan Goyal, Rachel Bartash
pmc-12722534.description: Objective:Concern for Pseudomonas aeruginosa in diabetic foot infections (DFIs) is common and a driving factor for empiric antibiotic prescribing, particularly among immunocompromised hosts. This study sought to identify the prevalence of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in DFIs among kidney transplant recipients and the use of antipseudomonal agents for empiric antibiotic coverage.Design:Retrospective cohort study.Setting:Large, urban, tertiary care transplant center.

pmc-13187244.title: Targeting ZMIZ1 induces differentiation in acute myeloid leukemia via chromatin remodeling
pmc-13187244.creator: Huimin Li, Yabin Liu, Jiachen Cui, Ziyu Fu, Yiyang Xu, Sizhe Yang, Kai Zhu, Yuhao Xue, Yi Zhang, Yiheng Zhao, Guiqiyang Xiang, Xiaoguang Xu, Fulun Jiao, Shuting Yu, Qiang Wang, Yuting Dai, Qianqian Zhang, Jianfeng Li, Ruihong Zhang, Fangyi Dong, Shanhe Yu, Shengyue Wang, Saijuan Chen, Bo Jiao, Shuo
pmc-13187244.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is an aggressive hematologic malignancy characterized by profound transcriptional dysregulation and impaired hematopoietic differentiation. While differentiation therapy has revolutionized treatment in acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL), analogous strategies in non-APL AML remain elusive. Here, we identify ZMIZ1 (Zinc finger MIZ domain-containing protein 1) as a previously unrecognized transcriptional co-regulator that enforces differentiation blockade in AML from a targeted CRISPR-Cas9 screen. ZMIZ1 expression is elevated in AML patients and correlates with adverse outcomes.

pmc-13194914.title: Are amblyopia therapy outcomes related to socioeconomic situation for children in Greater Manchester?
pmc-13194914.creator: Laura England, Catherine Fullwood, Jignasa Mehta, Kerry Hanna, Anna O’Connor
pmc-13194914.description: BackgroundLimited evidence exists around health inequalities in amblyopia therapy. This cohort study explores amblyopia therapy outcomes and socioeconomic scores by postcode, across two boroughs within Greater Manchester.MethodsAll available orthoptic records for school vision screening referrals from the academic year 2017–2018 were reviewed by one Research Orthoptist, to identify children diagnosed with unilateral amblyopia.

pmc-13298304.title: Decoupling Foam Stability from Formation Damage: Interfacial Pseudo-Gelation via Nanoparticle–Fluorosurfactant Synergy for Unconventional Reservoirs
pmc-13298304.creator: Hongjian Wu, Xiangwei Kong
pmc-13298304.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A critical challenge in coalbed methane (CBM) extraction is the severe formation damage induced by conventional foam fracturing fluids, primarily through polymer retention and hydrogen bond disruption within the microporous matrix. This study presents a molecularly engineered, low-damage foam fracturing fluid that leverages synergistic nanoparticle–surfactant interactions to construct a robust interfacial pseudo-gel network, thereby decoupling effective fracture stimulation from adverse geochemical damage.

pmc-13364964.title: Integration of transcriptomic data reveals lipid metabolic heterogeneity and identifies GSTO1 as a therapeutic target in acute myeloid leukemia
pmc-13364964.creator: Fangmin Zhong, Zihao Wang, Jialin Huang, Linfeng Jin, Fangyi Yao, Xiaozhong Wang
pmc-13364964.description: BackgroundAcute myeloid leukemia (AML) is an aggressive hematologic malignancy with poor prognosis and significant heterogeneity. Lipid metabolic reprogramming is a key hallmark of cancer, yet its systemic characterization and clinical relevance in AML remain largely unexplored.MethodsMulti-omics data were integrated, including one single-cell RNA-seq dataset and bulk transcriptomes from nine AML cohorts. Lipid metabolism activity was assessed using GSVA.

pmc-13386649.title: Evaluation of a disability-inclusive ultra-poor graduation programme in Bangladesh: study protocol for a cluster-randomised controlled trial
pmc-13386649.creator: Mark T. Carew, Semab Rahman, Lena Morgon Banks, Mohima Gomes, Md. Kamruzzaman, Narayan Das, Hannah Kuper
pmc-13386649.description: BackgroundThere remains a lack of evidence on which livelihoods interventions are effective for persons with disabilities, particularly given the fact that the impact of interventions varies according to contextual factors. The disability-inclusive ultra-poor graduation (DIUPG) programme is an adaptation of the ultra-poor graduation programme (UPG), designed to tackle extreme poverty among persons with disabilities.

pmc-13425971.title: Safety and feasibility of tumor treating fields initiated before and during radiotherapy for newly diagnosed glioblastoma: results from the Arm A feasibility cohort of a phase I/II trial (PriCoTTF)
pmc-13425971.creator: Sied Kebir, Christoph Oster, Sandeep Sharma, Leon Jekel, Teresa Schmidt, Jana Grieger, Giorgio Cappello, Kathrin Kizina, Lazaros Lazaridis, Laurèl Rauschenbach, Yahya Ahmadipour, Philipp Dammann, Andreas Junker, Kathy Keyvani, Jonas Feldheim, Daniela Pierscianek, Björn Scheffler, Martin Proescholdt, Peter Hau, Anca-Ligia Grosu, Dietmar Krex, Ulrich Sure, Christoph Kleinschnitz, Christoph Pöttgen, Martin Stuschke, Martin Glas

pmc-13579292.title: Divergent associations of TyG index and HOMA-IR with cardiovascular and cerebrovascular mortality in non-diabetic elderly: a competing risk analysis of NHANES 2003‒2020
pmc-13579292.creator: Xintian Xu, Xiaomei Ye, Chen Xiao, Yaozhuo Cai, Hao Chen, Xueli Cai, Jingping Sun
pmc-13579292.description: Highlights•In non-diabetic elderly, TyG index linearly, HOMA-IR J-shapedly, linked to CVDs death.•First competing risk model reveals HOMA-IR’s protection reflects higher non-CVDs death.•TyG and HOMA-IR lack incremental mortality prediction beyond CVDs risk factors.•TyG independently predicts stroke death in healthy elders, aiding primary prevention.

pmc-13675345.title: Combined effects of heat and rhamnolipids against Listeria monocytogenes: Influence of water activity and pH
pmc-13675345.creator: Gustavo Vasconcelos Gomes, Marcia Nitschke
pmc-13675345.description: Foodborne diseases remain a major public health concern, with Listeria monocytogenes being one of the most significant foodborne pathogens due to its high mortality rate and persistence in food-processing environments. This study evaluated the combined effects of heat, pH, and water activity on the antimicrobial activity of rhamnolipids (RL) against L. monocytogenes within the framework of hurdle technology.
